glossary.definition: (A) "License" means a license the Ohio construction industry licensing board issues to an individual as a heating, ventilating, and air conditioning contractor, refrigeration contractor, electrical contractor, plumbing contractor, or hydronics contractor.
glossary.source_title: Section 4740.01 - Construction industry licensing board definitions.
Section 4740.01 - Construction industry licensing board definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Contracting company" means a company in the construction industry working on construction projects.
glossary.source_title: Section 4740.01 - Construction industry licensing board definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Licensed trade" means a trade performed by a heating, ventilating, and air conditioning contractor, a refrigeration contractor, an electrical contractor, a plumbing contractor, or a hydronics contractor.
glossary.source_title: Section 4740.01 - Construction industry licensing board definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Tradesperson" means any individual who is employed by a contractor and who engages in construction, improvement, renovation, repair, or maintenance of buildings or structures without assuming responsibility for the means, method, or manner of that construction, improvement, renovation, repair, or maintenance.
glossary.source_title: Section 4740.01 - Construction industry licensing board definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Construction project" means a construction project involving a building or structure subject to Chapter 3781. of the Revised Code and the rules adopted under that chapter, but not an industrialized unit or a residential building as defined in section 3781.06 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4740.01 - Construction industry licensing board definitions.

glossary.definition: (G) "Training agency" means an entity approved by the administrative section of the board to provide continuing education courses.
glossary.source_title: Section 4740.01 - Construction industry licensing board definitions.
